premise.claim: The rbgs operator caches ALL Pods today (cacheOptions filters Service/StatefulSet/Deployment but not Pod), so unrelated Pods dominate operator memory (issue #284).
premise.evidence: scripts/kep284-static-checks.sh P0 checks; issue #284 pprof; code inspection of cmd/rbgs/main.go cacheOptions().
premise.note: Docs-only PR: premise verified statically; memory mechanism corroborated by issue #284 heap profiles, not re-measured.

round2.summary: PR revised from the four-source union design to the single-informer transform stub (the A-F3 alternative), with the in-repo reproducible harness test/podcacheunion. Reviewer re-ran: author's -race suite both gate configs (pass), the sync-heap diagnostic (reproduced: store-only streaming buffers whole objects until Replace, 71.3 MiB peak vs 18.3 MiB with the wrapper), direct TransformingStore assertion probes (KEP mechanism claim confirmed), a one-shape smoke campaign reproducing the headline -86% retained-heap figure on Linux amd64, and the drift contract suite (red by design until the implementation PR).
